behavior.validation: Accept exactly the required schema keys in plain passive JSON-compatible objects and dense ordinary arrays, with finite binary64 values and safe integer descriptors; no coercion, defaults, accessors, booleans-as-numbers or retained aliases. Complete static shape/value validation precedes work preflight. Geometric/topology tests run after preflight. Failure throws Error with stable code, no partial result. Outputs are detached. Canonicalize exposed signed zero to +0. Array lengths must fit 4294967295; unsafe requested growth/work arithmetic gives WORK_LIMIT before allocation. Host resource exhaustion is a host error, not an allocation guarantee. All grid/kernel/element dimensions are positive integers; each corresponding array length/product must fit 4294967295 and match exactly, otherwise INVALID_INPUT before work.
behavior.environment: No RNG, noise, time, rendering, assets, host state, mutation or retained aliases. Data uses caller coordinate/color conventions as specified.
behavior.numerics: Separate IEEE754 binary64 arithmetic, Math.hypot and host sin/cos/sqrt for the named formulas. Check computed numeric intermediates for finiteness and throw NUMERIC_OVERFLOW on nonfinite results. No epsilon in classification or topology, no adaptive exact predicates or near-degeneracy guarantee. General scalar/coordinate comparisons allow absolute 1e-9 plus relative 1e-12; topology, indices, order, booleans and RNG states compare exactly. Analytical shared fixtures use exact JSON output.
behavior.algorithm:
Input {values,columns,rows,kernel,kernelColumns,kernelRows,boundary,maxWork}; exact grid/kernel
products, odd positive kernel dimensions, boundary zero|clamp. Output {values}. This is convolution,
not correlation: for output x,y, sequentially sum K[ky*kC+kx]*sample(x+cx-kx,y+cy-ky), with
cx=floor(kC/2), cy=floor(kR/2); zero is 0 off-grid and clamp clamps coordinates. No normalization/clamp.
Work=cells*kernelCells before allocation. Fixtures: [2]*[3]=[6]; 3x1 [1,2,4] convolved with [1,2,4]
under zero -> [4,12,16], distinguishing reversed convolution from correlation. Studies: embossed dots;
ink-spread screen.
behavior.native_surface: p5.js named export convolve2DSigned(input) from packages/javascript/src/convolve-2d-signed.js. Other targets deferred.
